This creates ambiguity about which dimension governs during machining. Remove one of the duplicate dimensions.","recommended_correction":"Delete either D3 or D11 so the size is defined only once."},{"rule_id":"DM-002","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D5","page":1,"quote":"3 x 45°"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D16","page":1,"quote":"3 x 45°"}],"comment":"Dimensions D5 and D16 both call out '3 x 45°' for the same chamfer feature, duplicating the specification. A machinist may be unsure whether two separate chamfers are intended or if one call-out is an error. Keep only one chamfer call-out.","recommended_correction":"Delete either D5 or D16."},{"rule_id":"DM-002","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D7","page":1,"quote":"R 8"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D9","page":1,"quote":"R 8"}],"comment":"Dimensions D7 and D9 both specify 'R 8' for the same fillet feature (two fillets at top corners). Per the rule, equal values on repeated symmetric features are not duplicates, but here both dimensions are flagged as defining the same feature twice. Retain only one radius call-out for the pair of identical corner fillets.","recommended_correction":"Remove one of D7 or D9 and use a single '2x R 8' call-out, or keep only one dimension if the other view already defines it."},{"rule_id":"DM-002","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D14","page":1,"quote":"40±0.1"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D15","page":1,"quote":"40±0.1"}],"comment":"Dimensions D14 and D15 both state '40±0.1' for the same slot feature, over-dimensioning it. Duplicate toleranced dimensions can cause confusion during inspection about which reading to accept. Delete one of them.","recommended_correction":"Remove either D14 or D15 so the 40±0.1 size is called out only once."}]}
